Strict Target Size Ceiling: Enforces non-negotiable target size limits with clear diagnostics when unachievable
Interactive Media3 Timeline Trimmer: Live scrub seeking and interval playback loop with ExoPlayer
Multi-Selection & Batch Studios: Horizontal thumbnail strip navigation, Add More appending, and shared compression settings
10s Back Navigation Idle Purge: Automatically clears inactive tool memory when idle on Home
